_about: Opening hours of every ski lift for winter 2026-27, read by hand from the lift operators' timetables. tools/research_ski_descriptions.py adds an hours sentence from them to each lift description. open: first ride. close: time the lift stops (Morzine timetable). last_up: last ride up (Avoriaz timetable). open_school_holidays: earlier first ride in school holidays. periods: the closing times by date range. text: hand-written hours sentence used instead of the generated one. basis: lift (the lift's own timetable row), sector (a rule shared by every lift of its sector) or null (no hours known). Local French time.

avoriaz.note: Pre-opening weekend of 28 and 29 November 2026 on part of the area (Arare and Chavanette, according to Portes du Soleil). Two timetables: 11 December 2026 to 5 February 2027, then from 6 February 2027.

morzine.note: Pleney and Nyon-Chamossière sectors. Opening times differ in and out of school holidays, closing times in three periods.

les_gets.note: Partial opening on 12 December if there is enough natural snow. Some lifts may close earlier at the end of the season. The 2026-27 lift timetable is not published yet.

portes_du_soleil.note: Portes du Soleil gives 19 December 2026 for the whole linked area, the Avoriaz site gives 20 December 2026.
